messages:
Alex Chen: Hey @customer-success — my trial credits vanished when I tried to update a billing card. I completed card entry but the UI showed "payment setup failed" and credits went to 0. Account: acct_9X7A2B3. Can someone check?
Maria Gutierrez: Sorry you hit this — can you paste the account id and the time you saw the error? Any error text from the console helps.
Alex Chen: Account is acct_9X7A2B3, saw it around 2026-03-15 14:12 UTC. Console showed: `Error 402: payment_method_setup_failed` and a small toast "trial credits applied but revoked". Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshot/abc123
Billing Bot: Automated billing event: invoice.payment_failed for acct_9X7A2B3 at 2026-03-15T14:12:05Z (err code: pm_setup_failed)
Maria Gutierrez: Thanks. I'll open an internal ticket and escalate to finance. Can you confirm you didn't see any charges?
Alex Chen: No charges. Card entry page kept spinning, no transaction in bank.
Jason Patel: Looping in finance — we'll hold on reinstating trial credits until we confirm no charge hit. Tagging @CreditsBot to prepare a provisional top-up if needed.
CreditsBot: Action queued: provisional_credit +250 trial units to acct_9X7A2B3 pending manual approval by finance.
Jason Patel: Approved. I've temporarily reinstated 250 trial units as a one-time rollback while we investigate. This is an exception — filing a notes entry (INV-4471).
Maria Gutierrez: Thanks @Jason. Alex — can you try to update your billing method again? Once a card registers successfully the provisional credit will remain. If it fails again we'll keep the rollback and work with payments team.
Alex Chen: Trying now... entering new card, UI shows success ✅. No charge in bank. Credits are back, showing +250. Thanks all.
Maria Gutierrez: Great — marking thread resolved. I'll follow up with a short policy clarification to ops about auto-revoking credits on pm setup failures.
Alex Chen: Appreciate it :bow:
CreditsBot: Note appended to acct_9X7A2B3: provisional_credit applied by Jason Patel for payment setup failure on 2026-03-15.
